<includeonly>{{Auto images/aux
|title={{{title|}}}
|align={{{align|}}}
|cont={{{cont|}}}
|footer={{{footer|}}}
|total_width={{{total_width|600}}}
<!--Calculate ht, the common height of the images which makes the total width correct.
    Subtract 10 from the total width for each image to allow for padding round each image.-->
|ht={{#expr:({{{total_width|600}}} - {{#if:{{{width1|}}}|10|0}} - {{#if:{{{width2|}}}|10|0}} - {{#if:{{{width3|}}}|10|0}} - {{#if:{{{width4|}}}|10|0}} - {{#if:{{{width5|}}}|10|0}} -
{{#if:{{{width6|}}}|10|0}}) /
{{#expr:{{#ifeq:{{{height1|0}}}|0|0|{{#expr:{{{width1|0}}}/{{{height1|1}}} }} }} +
{{#ifeq:{{{height2|0}}}|0|0|{{#expr:{{{width2|0}}}/{{{height2|1}}} }} }} +
{{#ifeq:{{{height3|0}}}|0|0|{{#expr:{{{width3|0}}}/{{{height3|1}}} }} }} +
{{#ifeq:{{{height4|0}}}|0|0|{{#expr:{{{width4|0}}}/{{{height4|1}}} }} }} +
{{#ifeq:{{{height5|0}}}|0|0|{{#expr:{{{width5|0}}}/{{{height5|1}}} }} }} +
{{#ifeq:{{{height6|0}}}|0|0|{{#expr:{{{width6|0}}}/{{{height6|1}}} }} }} }} }}
|width1={{{width1|}}}|image1={{{image1|}}}|caption1={{{caption1|}}}|alt1={{{alt1|}}}
|ar1={{#expr:{{#ifeq:{{{height1|0}}}|0|1|{{#expr:{{{width1|0}}}/{{{height1|1}}}}}}}}}
|width2={{{width2|}}}|image2={{{image2|}}}|caption2={{{caption2|}}}|alt2={{{alt2|}}}
|ar2={{#expr:{{#ifeq:{{{height2|0}}}|0|1|{{#expr:{{{width2|0}}}/{{{height2|1}}}}}}}}}
|width3={{{width3|}}}|image3={{{image3|}}}|caption3={{{caption3|}}}|alt3={{{alt3|}}}
|ar3={{#expr:{{#ifeq:{{{height3|0}}}|0|1|{{#expr:{{{width3|0}}}/{{{height3|1}}}}}}}}}
|width4={{{width4|}}}|image4={{{image4|}}}|caption4={{{caption4|}}}|alt4={{{alt4|}}}
|ar4={{#expr:{{#ifeq:{{{height4|0}}}|0|1|{{#expr:{{{width4|0}}}/{{{height4|1}}}}}}}}}
|width5={{{width5|}}}|image5={{{image5|}}}|caption5={{{caption5|}}}|alt5={{{alt5|}}}
|ar5={{#expr:{{#ifeq:{{{height5|0}}}|0|1|{{#expr:{{{width5|0}}}/{{{height5|1}}}}}}}}}
|width6={{{width6|}}}|image6={{{image6|}}}|caption6={{{caption6|}}}|alt6={{{alt6|}}}
|ar6={{#expr:{{#ifeq:{{{height6|0}}}|0|1|{{#expr:{{{width6|0}}}/{{{height6|1}}}}}}}}}
}}</includeonly><noinclude>
{{template doc}}
<!-- Add categories and interwikis to the /doc subpage, not here! -->
</noinclude>
